notes.title: War matchmaking changes & 2 Unreal cubes
notes.notes:
[h1]War Matchmaking Changes[/h1]
We've heard your recent questions regarding the matchmaking logic we shared here in 2022.

After further investigation, we noticed we made some mistakes when implementing it, which we will be fixing shortly.
Alongside these bug fixes, we will be using the average of main players Starbase level only instead of the average Starbase level of all planets.

For most alliances this has almost no effect, but for those at the top, they can see up to a 2x increase in possible opponents.
We have considered these changes thoroughly and even asked some community members about them, and everyone seems to agree it's good!

These changes will be coming Saturday, 3 May 2025 14:00 (UTC+2 timezone)!
We will make an updated post with the update in ⁠dev-blog with the details, for those who want them.
Thanks to Patric for guiding me with all of this

[h1]Quoicoucube VI[/h1]
Thanks to PoLisz' support, we are sending out a Kamikaze themed cube for everyone to open.
The cube will be sent out in just a moment!

Drop rates:
50% 80 marine + 80 flamethrower + 80 bazooka + 80 kamikaze
19% 32 menders + 64 wasp
8% 2 gold refills
6% 10 binding material + 20 engine
5% 10 ravager pack
5% 16 binding materials + 32 engine + 24 boulder rock
4% 20 smasher squad
2% horror pack
1% doom pack

[h1]Solaris II[/h1]
Thanks to Floridant's support, he is sending out his second cube for everyone to open.
We will be sending out this cube Saturday evening somewhere, a few hours after the update!

The droprates are similar to Solaris, his first cube.
Each cube in-game has an equal chance to drop, this includes some of the other Unreal cubes!
The change is that the Refinery cubes have been decreased in drop rate, so the others have a higher chance.

notes.title: Galaxy Life downtime update
notes.notes:
[b]Downtime status update[/b]

The computer handling the transfer in the previous post just suddenly lost internet connection and we're on the phone with the internet service provider. The issues remain ongoing even after being reassured that it will be fixed by our ISP. 

We will continue to monitor the situation and we will post an announcement when we regain service. We will be switching internet service providers on Monday as well as adding a second line as soon as we can to hopefully prevent this from ever possibly happening again. 

Again, we're very sorry for the inconvenience and thank you all for your continuous support, understanding, and patience, everyone will be compensated in chips once the game is back online.

notes.notes:
The first tests show good results, the new system is very fast and appears to remain very consistent. This however is only upon storing data, since this new system is a big change it took a bit to rewrite our access methods to it.
Tomorrow is the day in which we will start testing using it entirely in place of what we currently use on staging. If these initial tests go well we will expand on the amount of testers we have to ensure the stability remains the same even with a lot of players active(this is the issue we had in the first week of launch)

If all goes well we will slowly migrate all the data and push the change into production allowing all of you to enjoy it!

[b]Welcome back chief![/b]


[b]Contest[/b]
It's the season for looting. Spread love through destruction and dominate the galaxy. With today's update we'll be introducing a brand new contest to the game for valentines! To participate in this contest press the hearts icon at the top left of your screen when entering the game.

Your Galaxy Life Team

notes.title: Open beta back online! - Small patch notes
notes.notes:
The open beta is finally back and much more stable than before, during this downtime we decided to start looking into bug fixes next to stability changes and made loads of progress this includes the following changes:

- Optimized user data storage for faster loading
- Optimized networking to only load absolutely needed data (instead of everything)
- Removed optional respectful saving (it now always saves respectfully)
- Reduced needed commands to load a user
- Fixed slowdowns on startup
- Fixed planet colonization
- Fixed a bug preventing you from losing troops after battles
- Fixed a bug where you kept getting obstacles after each refresh
- Fixed a bug where you would forever be under attack
- Fixed an issue where everyone would get the same target from target finder
- FIxed an issue where you could get infinite mystery cubes from the refinery

For the upcoming few days we'll be looking into fixing much more and improving upon stability even more, we hope everyone is looking forward to the future for Galaxy Life!
